proposal.name: Answer plumbing issues on other repositories

plan.name: Answer plumbing issues on other repositories
plan.summary: When the repository a watcher watches isn't Invariant's own, gitdek/invariant, the factory no longer plans a `Kind: plumbing` issue: in answer to the command that asked for a draft, it posts one `unsupported` answer, labels the issue `invariant:human-review-needed`, and drafts nothing, so the planner never runs, no agent run is recorded, and the issue is left open for a person. The answer says plumbing isn't supported on this repository yet, and why: the gate workflow `invariant init` writes doesn't run the repository's tests or check a plan's ratification, the build and review prompts describe Invariant, the trusted base is Invariant's own layout, and the sandbox has no way to fetch the repository's dependencies. A later `/invariant revise` gets the same answer, and still no draft. On gitdek/invariant, a plumbing issue is planned as now: the existing plumbing tests' rig runs as gitdek/invariant, and SPEC.md's plumbing bullet gains a line saying plumbing works only there for now.

tests.name: TestPlumbingElsewhereGetsOneAnswerAndNoDraft
tests.says: On a repository that isn't Invariant's, a plumbing issue gets one answer, labeled for a person, saying plumbing isn't supported there yet and why, and nothing is drafted: no planner run, no recorded agent run and no branch.

tests.name: TestOnlyInvariantsOwnRepositoryPlansPlumbing
tests.says: The same plumbing issue gets a plan on gitdek/invariant, as now, and the answer instead of a plan on another repository.

tests.name: TestARevisedPlumbingIssueElsewhereIsStillNotDrafted
tests.says: A writer's /invariant revise on such an issue gets the same answer, and still nothing is drafted.

usage.summary:
The plan passed the check on the first try: all three acceptance tests fail on the code as it is. On any repository other than gitdek/invariant, the factory will answer a `Kind: plumbing` issue once, saying plumbing isn't supported there yet and giving the issue's four reasons, then label it `invariant:human-review-needed` for a person and draft nothing (a later `/invariant revise` gets the same answer), while on gitdek/invariant it plans the issue as it does now. Because the change touches `internal/factory`, which is part of the trusted base, a person has to merge it.

Files are in the working directory:
- `plan.json`
- `tests/internal/factory/plumbing_elsewhere_accept_test.go`
